name: mathmodel-skill
description: A stateful ten-stage workflow with source-anchored problem interpretation, evidence-based MATLAB figures, paper traceability, and compliance review for CUMCM, MCM/ICM, Diangong Cup, and Huawei Cup graduate modeling.

interface.shortDescription: 让四类数学建模竞赛从题意到终稿形成可核验链路
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native mathematical modeling competition workflow that traces problem requirements to models and deliverables, registers figures as reproducible evidence, and traces paper claims back to validated results. Ten staged checkpoints, persistent state, competition-specific rules, deterministic helpers, and compliance-first review keep long-running collaboration coherent.
defaultPrompt: Use $mathmodel-skill to guide my CUMCM team from kickoff to submission.
Use $mathmodel-skill to compare MCM problem choices and record the decision.
Use $mathmodel-skill to prepare my Huawei Cup team and audit problem interpretation.
Use $mathmodel-skill to run a compliance-first final review of our modeling paper.
